### Invoices

Submit and track invoices.

#### `POST /invoices`

**Submit an invoice**

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idempotency-key` | header | string | Replaying the same key returns the original result; a different body is a 409. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Sync mode: the AT milestone was reached before the timeout |
| `202` | Accepted and queued |
| `400` | Schema or transformation failure — both source and target paths are named |
| `401` | Missing or invalid API key |
| `403` | The key lacks `invoices:write`; the response names the required scope |
| `409` | Idempotency key reused with a different body |
| `413` | Body exceeds the size limit |
| `429` | Rate limited — see Retry-After |

#### `GET /invoices`

**List submissions**

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | query | string |  |
| `sellerId` | query | string |  |
| `documentType` | query | string |  |
| `from` | query | string |  |
| `to` | query | string |  |
| `limit` | query | integer |  |
| `cursor` | query | string | Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page. Cursor, not offset: an offset skips rows under concurrent inserts. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of submissions |
| `403` | Requires `invoices:read` |

#### `POST /invoices/{id}/ack`

**Acknowledge receipts**

Makes receipts purge-eligible after RECEIPT_ACK_GRACE_DAYS. A replay is a no-op.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | { acknowledged: n } |

#### `POST /render`

**Render arbitrary FatturaPA or notification XML**

Official AdE stylesheet. Lets a CRM display an invoice PASSO has already purged.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | query | string | Notification type (RC, NS, …) when the body is a receipt |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | HTML |
| `400` | Empty body or over PASSO_MAX_RENDER_BYTES |

#### `POST /invoices/{id}/retry`

**Retry a failed submission**

REFUSES an NS (terminal — issue a new invoice) and an MC (still delivering).

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `202` | Requeued |
| `409` | NS or MC — retrying would duplicate at the tax authority |

| `200` | XML |
| `410` | Purged after a terminal receipt — PASSO is a relay, not an archive |

#### `GET /invoices/{id}/rendered`

**Human-readable rendering via the official AdE stylesheet**

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | HTML |
| `410` | Purged |

#### `GET /invoices/{id}/export`

**Pre-purge export package**

Everything PASSO holds for one submission — XML, rendering, receipts and hashes — in one call. Hashes are computed over the PLAINTEXT XML bytes so you can verify them independently. Take this BEFORE the terminal receipt arrives: afterwards the payload is purged and this returns 410.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The complete package |
| `410` | Purged — PASSO holds no archive and there is no recovery path |

#### `GET /pending`

**Submissions awaiting acknowledgement**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Unacknowledged receipts — these are never purged |

### Webhooks

Subscriptions and delivery history.

#### `POST /webhooks`

**Create a subscription**

The signing secret is returned ONCE and never again.

|---|---|
| `201` | Created; `secret` is shown once |

#### `POST /webhooks/{id}/rotate-secret`

**Rotate the signing secret**

Both signatures are sent during the overlap window, so a receiver can redeploy without downtime. Parse EVERY `v1=` in the header, not just the last.

|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The new secret and the overlap window |

#### `POST /inbound/{token}`

**Vendor notification callback**

Where Invoicetronic and OpenAPI.it push receipts. Authenticated by the per-tenant token in the path — vendor consoles frequently cannot send custom headers. Returns 200 even for a duplicate or a quarantine, so the vendor stops retrying something already handled.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | string |  |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Received (applied, duplicate or quarantined) |
| `400` | Unparseable — the payload is never echoed back |
| `401` | Unknown token |
| `413` | Body exceeds the inbound limit, refused before parsing |

### Reference

Error codes, events and scopes.

#### `POST /privacy/erasure`

**Data-subject erasure enquiry**

Reports what PASSO actually holds for a subject. Almost always: nothing beyond configuration, because the CRM holds the archive. An in-flight document is refused for the LIVE TRANSMISSION, never for a retention duty PASSO does not have.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | What is held, and whether it is erasable |
| `400` | No subject identifier supplied |
